name: ATM Device Control V 04
definition: The ATMDeviceControl message is sent by a maintenance host to an ATM in response to an ATMDeviceReport message. The message contains a sequence of maintenance commands the ATM must perform.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMDeviceControl.name: ATM Device Control
ATMDeviceControl.definition: Information related to the control of an ATM device.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
